name: Return to Denalan
summary: At Lake Al'Ameth, Return to Denalan carries Rellian's alarming news to the botanist studying corruption in Teldrassil. After examining the mossy tumors on timberlings, you head south to help Denalan with his discovery.

sections.title: A Message Across the Boughs
sections.body: Rellian Greenspyre studies the mossy tumors afflicting Teldrassil's timberlings when urgent word arrives from his colleague Denalan. At his camp beside Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan has finally isolated the cause of these unnatural growths on the forest's nature spirits. Rellian recognizes the gravity of this discovery and sends you south at once to lend a hand.

sections.title: The Threat at the Lake
sections.body: At Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan faces blighted beings poisoning Teldrassil's boughs. His work begins with corrupted plants and diseased timberlings, then brings him into direct conflict with the corrupted timberling Oakenscowl.

faq.answer: Denalan is a night elf researcher and naturalist at Lake Al'Ameth in southern Teldrassil. He studies the island's plants, strange seedling mutations, and the unnatural afflictions spreading among local timberlings.

faq.q: Why does Rellian Greenspyre send you back to Lake Al'Ameth?
faq.answer: Rellian receives word that Denalan has found the likely root cause of the tumors corrupting timberlings. The discovery is still unfolding rapidly and poses a growing danger to the forest, so Rellian sends you to help in the field at once.

faq.q: What are the tumors afflicting the timberlings?
faq.answer: Timberlings are peaceful nature spirits born from the island's plant life, but corruption taking root in Teldrassil makes bizarre mossy growths sprout on them. These tumors leave the creatures hostile and maddened.
Denalan has a camp on the shores of Lake Al'Ameth, just south of Dolanaar in Teldrassil's southern woodlands.

faq.q: What happens after you reach Denalan?
faq.answer: Denalan welcomes your help and says he has discovered something disturbing. He explains what comes next when you reach his camp.

faq.q: How does this errand connect Rellian and Denalan?
aliases: why does rellian send me to denalan
faq.answer: Rellian Greenspyre studies timberlings in Darnassus, while Denalan works from his camp at Lake Al'Ameth. Rellian's research into the tumors reaches Denalan, whose new discovery concerns their cause.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know timberlings as living signs of Teldrassil's vitality. Helping Denalan is part of your duty to heal the corruption threatening your people's new home.
As a druid, you know that investigating unnatural tumors on woodland spirits serves the Cenarion duty to keep nature in balance and cleanse blights.
